key_insight: A GNN autoencoder compresses detonation flows into latent graphs while preferentially preserving wavefront profiles and triple points over downstream deflagrative structures.
engineering_relevance: Compact graph representations could support accelerated detonation simulations by retaining key wavefront features across different flow configurations.
method: Encode detonation flow fields into reduced latent graphs using a GNN autoencoder.
Reconstruct cellular detonation structures through local message passing.
Evaluate extrapolation from uniform 2D hydrogen–air detonations to stratified and 3D configurations.
evidence_signal: In the uniform 2D case, latent graphs with effective resolution twice the induction length reconstructed the wavefront and post-shock region; extrapolation at fixed ambient conditions retained wavefront structure in stratified and 3D detonations.
watch_item: Reconstruction favors wavefront features over downstream deflagrative regions, so fidelity across the full flow field should be checked before simulation use.
paper_title: Reduced graph-based representations of detonation-containing flows
